subject: expn
title: EXPN.------PROG.CONT.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(II)-8. The prose above identifies: 'transformation, by its very definition, functions as a factor to reshape a given vibrational or physical universe situation. The realness of this phenomenon will comment on the changing nature of political and social dynamics.' The crossing diagrams how EXPN structurally meets progressional-continuance at the transformational-reshape scale: EXPN crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). EXPN sits at left with the subject-arrow; PROG-CONT at upper-right as partner-axis. ACT (activism) branches from the main line at upper-left and carries ALT-FT (alternative functionalism), which carries DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism). INFO-DY (information dynamics) runs right from the main line and carries MT-INFO (multi-information), which carries PER-DY (perception dynamics). APL-DT (application dictates) center, IST-F-ACT (isolated-focus activism) lower-right. ECO-DY (economic dynamics) drops from the main line to the lower left and carries (R)INT (reality of intention) and POL-P (political policies); APL-DT rises from the POL-P line and carries IST-F-ACT.
